rules.direction: From batch 5 (2026-10-18) new themes are commercial and practical (finance and insurance, schools and kindergartens, manufacturing, corporate sites, clinics, associations) with a Japanese-minimal look (generous white space, hairlines, restrained palettes, refined Noto/Zen/BIZ UD/Shippori type), never Japan-only subjects (basketry, kimono, wagashi, shrines, tea ceremony, dojo, crafts, pottery, tabi and the like). Palette colour names may be traditional Japanese names but the tones stay calm and businesslike. Hero imagery stays restrained, not flashy.
rules.even_use_skip_note: category is exempt from the even-use spread since batch 5: the commercial direction deliberately weights business-services and education-classes. The adjacent-rows-differ rule on category still applies.

nav_note: Every theme has a real global top header (site title/logo + primary nav + CTA). side-rail/overlay/split describe the primary-nav arrangement on top of that header, never a replacement.
image_note: cutout-break-frame = transparent-background WebP objects that overlap frames, text or colour fields (破格). real-photography = photorealistic photography-style images generated with Grok Build (scripts/grok-image.sh), prompted with a photo direction (lens, lighting, grain) and colour-graded toward the theme main colour; no stock fetching. For real-photography rows the illustration column holds a photo direction (enums.photo_direction) instead of an illustration style.
